overview.title: Discover Ksar Tinghir
overview.p1: Historic mudbrick fortified quarter with alleys, adobe towers and living Amazigh heritage.
overview.p2: Ksar Tinghir is a highlight of the Tinghir area on Morocco's desert route. Allow enough time to walk and take photos.
overview.p3: Combine with other Tinghir sites the same day. Wear sturdy shoes and carry water.

food.title: Where to eat near Ksar Tinghir
food.p1: Simple restaurants and cafés in Tinghir or near the site. Tagines, grills and mint tea.
food.p2: Cash is useful for small local places.

1.title: Access
1.desc: In the old town of Tinghir — walkable from the centre; public alleys of the ksar.

2.title: Timing
2.desc: Early morning or late afternoon for fewer crowds and softer light.

3.title: Respect
3.desc: Respect villagers, gardens and the natural site.

q1.question: How much time for Ksar Tinghir?

q2.question: Is it suitable for children?
q2.answer: Yes with supervision near cliffs and uneven paths.

q3.question: Do I need a guide?
q3.answer: Not required for a short walk in public alleys; useful for history and restored sections.

q4.question: How to get there?
q4.answer: By road from Tinghir on the desert route.
